t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Take advantage of the 5 min breaks within the game but also make sure you are somewhere quiet and comfortable to do the game so you can concentrate.

vb_textbox.text: Make sure that you have a comfortable space to complete the test as it takes a little bit of time, but it is quite fun to guess which gnome will get you the best number of mushrooms each time. Make sure you concentrate so that you don't miss a gnome or a basket. Practice first as well as sometimes it was easy to press the wrong button and get timed out.
